SELECT DISTINCT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%methotrexate%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%infliximab%' 
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%adalimumab%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%etanercept%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%golimumab%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%certolizumab%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tocilizumab%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%sarilumab%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%rituximab%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ustekinumab%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%abatacept%'
LIMIT 40;

SELECT DISTINCT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE standard_concept = 'S' 
  AND (vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' OR vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED')
  AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%hepatotoxicity%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%liver injury%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%transaminitis%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%alanine aminotransferase%'
  OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%aspartate aminotransferase%'
LIMIT 30;

SELECT DISTINCT c1.concept_id, c1.concept_name, c2.concept_name as class_name
FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
JOIN omop.concept c1 ON ca.descendant_concept_id = c1.concept_id
JOIN omop.concept c2 ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = c2.concept_id
WHERE LOWER(c2.concept_name) = 'biologic response modifier' OR LOWER(c2.concept_name) LIKE '%tumor necrosis factor%inhibitor%'
  AND c1.standard_concept = 'S'
LIMIT 30;

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_class_name) = 'Biologic' AND standard_concept = 'S'
LIMIT 50;
